title: 第21章 天品元胎被隐藏的秘密第22章 九皇子出尽风头演武场上召唤藏书阁
content_zh:
桃花峰别院。
圆月高悬。
大儒莫凡尘手捧圣贤书，秉烛而读，他的身体周围，有一道道浩然之气汇聚于头顶，将整个别院都笼罩在内。
“路虽远，行则将至，事虽难，做则可成。”
莫凡尘读到这，放下手上的书，缓缓起身，临窗眺月。
片刻后，他收回目光，落在孙女莫晚云正在闭关的幽静小院，身上的浩然之气渐渐隐没。
“晚云呐，我虽能助你一时，却难护你一世，平日里让你多读书，你多有懈怠，常常枕书而睡，你虽然天资聪颖，然而凝练元胎，如万丈高楼之基，点点滴滴，都得靠自己去夯实。”
没有浩然之气环绕的莫凡尘，如同一尘世中读书的老儒生，看不出任何仙气。
他仰望青萍山，感慨道：“圣人云，海不辞水，故能成其大，山不辞土，故能成其高，希望你能凭借自己的毅力凝练出元胎，总不至于连上品元胎都无法凝结吧？”
就在此时，莫凡尘若有所感，仰望星空中的元气漩涡，目光渐渐变得深邃。
“这青云门，倒也有趣。”莫凡尘走出房间，身上的青衫儒袍鼓荡，浩然之气纯正无比，他的表情陡然变得严肃，低语道：“圣院天书中有记载，大千世界，王朝五百年兴，五百年衰，是为大争之世，妖族横行，称霸一方，风头盖过魔族，连上界仙人都无法压制妖族崛起，沧海桑田，岁月轮转，也该到我人族大兴之世了吧。”
正说话间，隔壁小院涌出一道金色的元胎之气。
莫凡尘见状，微微颔首。
他深知孙女莫晚云向来贪玩，没有挖掘出足够的天赋，没有去努力修行，只能凝练出二品元胎，没想到竟然是金色一品元胎，虽然没有达到那传说中的天品元胎，但能够凝结一品，已属不易。
“也还不错。”
莫凡尘移步，打算进小院为莫晚云护法，因为金色元胎之气显兆，接下来会有极大的风险。
然而，莫凡尘抬起步子，只见金色的元胎之气，赫然有一道道霞光涌现。
“什么！”
莫凡尘瞳孔中一缩，先是一喜，随即反应过来，随手一挥，一卷圣书从袖子中飞出，冉冉升上天空，将整个青云门的天机遮掩。
“竟然是天品元胎。”

莫凡尘神色呐呐。
“晚云，爷爷小看了你……你究竟是什么时候改变自我，在暗地里努力修行的？原来我给你看的那些书，你都有真正的用功，若非如此，绝不会凝结出天品元胎的。”
同一时间，桃花林尽头，瀑布遮掩的寒洞中。
顾余生身体周围泛起七彩琉璃之芒。
他身如琉璃宝瓶。
天地间的元气如劲风呼呼刮过，盘亘在他头顶上方，被他吸入体内。
元胎境，在佛门大宗也被称作宝瓶境。
身染尘埃，则身如泥瓶。
心有明镜，则可以身化琉璃宝瓶。
此刻。
顾余生处于一种玄妙的境界，仿佛魂魄短暂的脱离了身体的束缚，一点点的飘荡在天空。
他一点点的上升，青萍山依旧若隐若现。
可天空中，随着元气的凝结，仿佛被生生撕开一条口子，苍穹深处，有一道苍古的气息弥漫，好似有一只奇特的眼睛穿界而来，突然间朝他看来。
顾余生心中一惊。
刹那间天崩地塌，好似天地渺渺，人如蜉蝣，如沧海一粟，命如蝼蚁之小。
他的灵魂如同在风雨飘摇，难以回归到身体。
“怎么回事？”
顾余生心中骇然，他低头，好似能看穿山脉，寻找到自己的宝瓶肉身，却被一股神秘的力量牵引，无法回去。
“难道是我走火入魔了吗？”
顾余生感觉到自己在坠入黑暗。

就在此时，天空中有一道光陡然升起，仔细看去，却是一本充斥着浩然之气的圣书，那光虽然微弱，洒照在他灵魂上却十分舒服。
content_en:
Peach Blossom Peak Villa.
The full moon hangs high.
The great scholar Mo Fanchen held the sage's book in his hand and read it with a candle. Around his body, there were waves of awe-inspiring energy gathered above his head, covering the entire other courtyard.
"Although the road is long, you will get there if you go. Even though the task is difficult, you can achieve it if you do it."
After Mo Fanchen read this, he put down the book in his hand, stood up slowly, and looked at the moon from the window.
After a moment, he withdrew his gaze and landed on the quiet courtyard where his granddaughter Mo Wanyun was retreating. The aura of awe in his body gradually disappeared.
"Wanyun, although I can help you for a while, I can't protect you for the rest of your life. I ask you to study more on weekdays, but you tend to slack off and often sleep with books on your pillow. Although you are talented and intelligent, the condensed Yuan Fei is like the foundation of a tall building. Every bit of it must be solidified by yourself."
Mo Fanchen, who is not surrounded by aura of awe-inspiring aura, is like an old Confucian scholar studying in the mortal world, unable to see any immortal aura.
He looked up at Qingping Mountain and said with emotion: "The sage said, the sea does not shy away from water, so it can become as big as it does, and the mountain does not shy away from soil, so it can become as high as it is. I hope you can condense the Yuan Fei with your own perseverance, so you won't be able to condense even high-grade Yuan Fei, right?"
At this moment, Mo Fanchen felt something, looking up at the vortex of vitality in the starry sky, his eyes gradually became deeper.
"This Qingyun Sect is quite interesting." Mo Fanchen walked out of the room, his green Confucian robes swaying, and his aura of awe-inspiring purity was extremely pure. His expression suddenly became serious, and he whispered: "It is recorded in the Heavenly Book of the Holy Academy that in the vast world, the Five Dynasties One hundred years of prosperity and five hundred years of decline. This is a time of great strife. The demon clan is rampant and dominates one area. Even the immortals in the upper world cannot suppress the rise of the demon clan. As time goes by, it is time for our human race to prosper. "
While he was talking, a golden Yuan Fei Qi came out of the small courtyard next door.
When Mo Fanchen saw this, he nodded slightly.
He knew very well that his granddaughter Mo Wanyun had always been playful and did not discover enough talent and did not practice hard. She could only condense a second-grade Yuan Fei. Unexpectedly, it turned out to be a golden first-grade Yuan Fei. Although she did not reach the legendary heaven-grade Yuan Fei, it was not easy to condense a first-grade Yuan Fei.
"Not bad either."
Mo Fanchen moved and planned to enter the small courtyard to protect Mo Wanyun. Because the energy of the golden Yuan Fei was showing signs, there would be great risks in the future.
However, Mo Fanchen raised his steps and saw streaks of golden Yuan Fei Qi emerging.
"What!"
Mo Fanchen's pupils shrank, he was happy at first, then he reacted and with a wave of his hand, a holy book flew out of his sleeve and slowly rose into the sky, covering the entire Qingyun Sect's secrets.
"It turns out to be a Tianpin Yuan Fei."
Mo Fanchen looked confused.
"Wanyun, grandpa underestimated you... When did you change yourself and practice hard in secret? It turns out that you really studied the books I showed you. Otherwise, you would never have condensed the heavenly Yuan Fei."
At the same time, at the end of the peach blossom forest, in a cold cave covered by a waterfall.
Gu Yusheng's body glowed with colorful glaze.
His body is like a glass vase.
The vitality between heaven and earth was blowing like a strong wind, hovering above his head and being inhaled into his body.
The Yuan Fei Realm is also called the Aquarius Realm in Buddhism.
If the body is stained with dust, the body will be like a clay bottle.
If you have a clear mirror in your heart, you can transform into a glass vase.
now.
Gu Yusheng was in a mysterious state, as if his soul had briefly escaped from the shackles of his body and was floating in the sky bit by bit.
As he ascended little by little, Qingping Mountain was still looming.
But in the sky, as the vitality condensed, a hole seemed to be torn open. Deep in the sky, there was an ancient aura permeating the sky, as if a strange eye came through the world and suddenly looked at him.
Gu Yusheng was shocked.
In an instant, the sky collapsed and the earth collapsed, as if the heaven and earth were insignificant, people were like mayflies, like a drop in the ocean, and their lives were as small as ants.
His soul seemed to be wavering in the wind and rain, and it was difficult to return to his body.
"What's going on?"
Gu YuShocked in his heart, he lowered his head, as if he could see through the mountains and find his Aquarius body, but he was pulled by a mysterious force and could not go back.
"Did I go crazy?"
Gu Yusheng felt himself falling into darkness.
At this moment, a light suddenly rose in the sky. If he looked carefully, he saw that it was a holy book filled with awe-inspiring aura. Although the light was weak, it was very comfortable when it shone on his soul.
